article.title: Coming Up: Democracy Now! Election Night Special
article.content: Tune in to Democracy Now! on election night, Tuesday, November 3, for a 4-hour special broadcast. Join us from 8 p.m. to midnight ET. Democracy Now! will speak with guests from around the country about this historic midterm election as results come in. We will be streaming live at DemocracyNow.org and on our YouTube channel. Check your local Democracy Now! station for listings.
